assumptions: The target robot has validated left-right symmetry for the controlled joints.
Actuator delays, gains, force bounds, friction and thermal behavior are re-identified for the deployment robot.

confidence_rationale: Repeated real-robot stand-up and pendulum comparisons plus public environment code support the narrow result. Confidence is capped by one small robot, sagittal symmetry, manual candidate selection and unreported long-term mechanical loads.

evidence.note: Defines the symmetric end-to-end policy and reports repeated real stand-up and pendulum recovery comparisons.

evidence.locator: StandupEnv.apply_control, get_observation, step, apply_randomization and randomize_fall at 78457df
evidence.note: Maps the five-DoF interface, incremental control, termination, dynamics randomization and fallen-state initialization to official code.

question: 能否用一个轻量策略统一人形机器人的倒地起身与强扰动恢复？

safety_case.command_limits: Identify robot-specific joint position/speed, actuator torque/current/temperature, impact and control-rate envelopes; the paper's 4-7.3 J impacts are test conditions, not ratings.
safety_case.emergency_stop: Verify an independent emergency stop and safe torque-off response before supported or disturbance testing.
safety_case.protective_controls: Use a tether or padded capture where compatible, an exclusion zone, a repeatable low-energy disturbance rig, thermal/current monitoring and post-trial mechanical inspection.
safety_case.robot_specific_warning: Evidence is specific to the 70 cm, 7.5 kg Sigmaban and symmetric sagittal control; larger robots, lateral falls and asymmetrical contacts require a new design review.
safety_case.staged_deployment: Validate terminations and self-collision in simulation, then supported low-speed prone/supine motions, low-energy disturbances, and only then bounded unsupported trials; do not perform online exploration on unprotected hardware.

statement: 在 Sigmaban 的对称矢状面设置中，FRASA 用五类自由度的 CrossQ/SAC 策略统一了俯卧/仰卧起身和摆锤扰动恢复，并在重复实机试验中比 KFB 更快；该结论不覆盖侧向、非对称、大型机器人或长期机械疲劳，且部署前仍需人工筛除高应力策略。
